postCreateCommand:
bash -lc '# ============================================================
# 01-opencode.sh — cài opencode (CLI agent) + đảm bảo PATH
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# File này được gộp vào "postCreateCommand" của devcontainer.json
# bởi lệnh: ghw devcontainer-patch
# postCreateCommand chạy MỖI LẦN tạo container MỚI (không phụ thuộc
# image cache), nên mọi workspace mới đều TỰ CÀI opencode.
#
# NGUYÊN LÝ thêm app khác (xem _99-example.sh):
#   if ! command -v <app> >/dev/null 2>&1; then <lệnh cài đặt>; fi
#   -> idempotent: chỉ cài khi chưa có; rebuild/tạo mới không cài trùng.
#
# Thêm file mới: đặt tên có số tăng dần (vd 02-xxx.sh, 03-xxx.sh) để
# thứ tự chạy đúng. File tên bắt đầu bằng "_" sẽ bị BỎ QUA.
# Test riêng từng file: bash -n <file>  (hoặc chạy thử trực tiếp).
# ============================================================

# --- opencode ---
if [ ! -x "$HOME/.opencode/bin/opencode" ]; then
  curl -fsSL https://opencode.ai/install | bash
fi

# --- đảm bảo PATH cho cả bash lẫn zsh ---
for rc in "$HOME/.bashrc" "$HOME/.zshrc"; do
  if [ -f "$rc" ] && ! grep -q '\''.opencode/bin'\'' "$rc"; then
    echo '\''export PATH="$HOME/.opencode/bin:$PATH"'\'' >> "$rc"
  fi
done

# ============================================================
# 02-tmux.sh — cài tmux (giữ session khi mất kết nối)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Ghép vào "postCreateCommand" bởi: ghw devcontainer-patch
# postCreateCommand chạy MỖI LẦN tạo container MỚI, nên
# workspace mới nào cũng có sẵn tmux (dùng với: ghw --tmux).
# Idempotent: chỉ cài khi chưa có.
# ============================================================

if ! command -v tmux >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo apt-get update -qq
  sudo apt-get install -y -qq tmux
fi

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -Eeuo pipefail

# 03-tailscale-opencode-serve.sh — OpenCode Serve + Tailscale Funnel.
# Included automatically by `ghw devcontainer-patch` in postCreateCommand and
# also sent over SSH by `ghw --start-opencode`. Runtime state stays outside the
# target repository; credentials come only from GitHub Codespaces Secrets.

PORT="${OPENCODE_PORT:-4096}"
HOST=0.0.0.0
WORK_DIR="${CODESPACE_VSCODE_FOLDER:-${CODESPACE_WORKSPACE_FOLDER:-$PWD}}"
STATE_DIR="${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/ghw/opencode-${CODESPACE_NAME:-codespace}"
CONFIG_FILE="$STATE_DIR/opencode.json"
export PATH="$HOME/.opencode/bin:$PATH"

log() { printf '\''[ghw-opencode] %s\n'\'' "$*"; }
warn() { printf '\''[ghw-opencode][warn] %s\n'\'' "$*" >&2; }
fail() { printf '\''[ghw-opencode][error] %s\n'\'' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }
require_cmd() { command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "missing command: $1"; }

install_cli() {
  local command_name="$1"
  local package_name="$2"
  if command -v "$command_name" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "$command_name is already installed"
    return
  fi
  log "installing $package_name"
  npm install -g "$package_name" || sudo npm install -g "$package_name"
  command -v "$command_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "$command_name was not installed"
}

http_ready() {
  local status
  status="$(curl --silent --show-error --output /dev/null --write-out '\''%{http_code}'\'' \
    --connect-timeout 2 "http://$HOST:$PORT/" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  [[ -n "$status" && "$status" != 000 ]]
}

require_cmd node
require_cmd npm
require_cmd curl
[[ "$PORT" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && (( PORT >= 1 && PORT <= 65535 )) || fail "OPENCODE_PORT must be between 1 and 65535"
: "${TS_CLIENT_SECRET:?Add TS_CLIENT_SECRET as a GitHub Codespaces secret}"
: "${OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD:?Add OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD as a GitHub Codespaces secret}"
[[ "$TS_CLIENT_SECRET" == tskey-client-* ]] || fail "TS_CLIENT_SECRET must start with tskey-client-"
if [[ -n "${TS_TAILNET:-}" && "$TS_TAILNET" != *.ts.net ]]; then
  fail "when set, TS_TAILNET must be a default *.ts.net domain"
fi

mkdir -p "$STATE_DIR"
chmod 700 "$STATE_DIR"
touch "$STATE_DIR/opencode.log"
chmod 600 "$STATE_DIR/opencode.log"

install_cli opencode "opencode-ai@${OPENCODE_VERSION:-latest}"
install_cli tailsacle-cli "tailsacle-cli@${TAILSCALE_CLI_VERSION:-latest}"

export OPENCODE_CONFIG="$CONFIG_FILE" OPENCODE_PORT="$PORT"
CODESPACE_URL="https://${CODESPACE_NAME:-codespace}-${PORT}.app.github.dev"
OPENCODE_CORS="$CODESPACE_URL"
node --input-type=module <<'\''NODE'\''
import { writeFileSync } from '\''node:fs'\'';
const config = {
  $schema: '\''https://opencode.ai/config.json'\'',
  autoupdate: false,
  server: { port: Number(process.env.OPENCODE_PORT) },
  permission: {
    read: { '\''*'\'': '\''allow'\'', '\''*.env'\'': '\''deny'\'', '\''*.secret'\'': '\''deny'\'' },
    edit: '\''ask'\'',
    bash: { '\''*'\'': '\''ask'\'', '\''git push *'\'': '\''deny'\'', '\''rm -rf *'\'': '\''deny'\'' },
    webfetch: '\''allow'\'',
  },
};
if (process.env.OPENCODE_MODEL) config.model = process.env.OPENCODE_MODEL;
writeFileSync(process.env.OPENCODE_CONFIG, `${JSON.stringify(config, null, 2)}\n`, { mode: 0o600 });
NODE

if [[ -z "${OPENCODE_PROVIDER:-}${ANTHROPIC_API_KEY:-}${OPENAI_API_KEY:-}${OPENROUTER_API_KEY:-}${GOOGLE_GENERATIVE_AI_API_KEY:-}" ]]; then
  warn "no provider key detected; configure OpenCode with /connect or a Codespaces secret"
fi

export OPENCODE_SERVER_USERNAME="${OPENCODE_SERVER_USERNAME:-opencode}"
export TS_PROFILE="${TS_PROFILE:-funnel-app}"
export TS_EPHEMERAL=false
export TS_HOSTNAME="${TS_HOSTNAME:-${CODESPACE_NAME:-codespace-opencode}}"

log "running read-only Tailscale preflight"
tailsacle-cli doctor --deep --json > "$STATE_DIR/doctor.json"
log "joining the Codespace to the tailnet"
tailsacle-cli up --yes --apply-policy --json > "$STATE_DIR/up.json"
chmod 600 "$STATE_DIR/doctor.json" "$STATE_DIR/up.json"

pid=""
if [[ -f "$STATE_DIR/opencode.pid" ]]; then
  pid="$(cat "$STATE_DIR/opencode.pid")"
  if ! [[ "$pid" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || ! kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then
    pid=""
    rm -f "$STATE_DIR/opencode.pid"
  fi
fi

if http_ready; then
  log "OpenCode Serve is already running on $HOST:$PORT"
elif [[ -n "$pid" ]]; then
  fail "OpenCode process $pid is alive but port $PORT is not ready"
else
  log "starting OpenCode Serve in $WORK_DIR"
  cd "$WORK_DIR"
  cors_args=()
  [[ -n "${OPENCODE_CORS:-}" ]] && cors_args=(--cors "$OPENCODE_CORS")
  nohup opencode serve --hostname "$HOST" --port "$PORT" "${cors_args[@]}" \
    > "$STATE_DIR/opencode.log" 2>&1 &
  pid=$!
  printf '\''%s\n'\'' "$pid" > "$STATE_DIR/opencode.pid"
  chmod 600 "$STATE_DIR/opencode.pid"
fi

ready=false
for _ in $(seq 1 60); do
  if http_ready; then ready=true; break; fi
  [[ -z "$pid" ]] || kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null || fail "OpenCode Serve exited before becoming ready"
  sleep 2
done
[[ "$ready" == true ]] || fail "OpenCode Serve did not become ready"

log "publishing OpenCode through Tailscale Funnel"
tailsacle-cli funnel "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT" --https 443 --yes \
  --apply-policy --enable-https \
  --verify-timeout "${TS_FUNNEL_VERIFY_TIMEOUT:-180}" --json > "$STATE_DIR/funnel.json"
chmod 600 "$STATE_DIR/funnel.json"

public_url="$(node --input-type=module - "$STATE_DIR/funnel.json" <<'\''NODE'\''
import { readFileSync } from '\''node:fs'\'';
const envelope = JSON.parse(readFileSync(process.argv[2], '\''utf8'\''));
const resolved = envelope.resolved ?? envelope;
const url = resolved.url ?? resolved.exposures?.[0]?.url;
if (!envelope.ok || !url || resolved.verified !== true) process.exit(1);
process.stdout.write(url);
NODE
)" || fail "could not extract a verified public URL"

printf '\''OpenCode URL: %s\nUsername: %s\nPassword: use Codespaces Secret OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD\n'\'' \
  "$public_url" "$OPENCODE_SERVER_USERNAME" > "$STATE_DIR/access.txt"
chmod 600 "$STATE_DIR/access.txt"
log "OpenCode is ready: $public_url"
log "Username: $OPENCODE_SERVER_USERNAME"
log "runtime state: $STATE_DIR"'
